title: QA-CMIF:Accurate and Lightweight Cross-Modal Latent Imputation and Fusion for Fault-Tolerant sEMG-Inertial Hand Gesture Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2611.20124v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Fusing surface electromyography (sEMG) with inertial measurements is widely used for myoelectric prosthesis control and wearable human-machine interfaces. In daily wear, however, socket micro-displacement, electrode lift-off, and wire failures often corrupt an unknown subset of sEMG channels through burst artifacts, lift-off shocks, or open-circuit dropouts. Existing fusion networks mix all channels in the first convolutional layer, so a few corrupted electrodes contaminate the entire latent representation, whereas gate-only attenuation of corrupted channels discards the co-activation cues needed to separate fine-grained gestures. translated_title: QA-CMIF：面向容错式表面肌电-惯性手部手势识别的精准且轻量的跨模态潜在填补与融合方法
translated_abstract: 将表面肌电信号与惯性测量数据融合被广泛应用于肌电假肢控制和可穿戴人机接口。然而在日常佩戴中，电极座的微小位移、电极脱落以及导线故障，常会以突发伪影、脱落冲击或断路失效的形式破坏未知部分的sEMG通道。现有的融合网络在第一层卷积层就将所有通道混合，导致少数受损电极污染整个潜在表示；而仅对受损通道进行门控衰减的做法，又会丢弃区分细粒度手势所需的协同激活线索。我们提出了QA-CMIF，一个质量感知的跨模态潜在填补与融合框架：它对每个sEMG通道进行独立编码，通过软门控评估通道可靠性，并利用置信度加权的残差旁路保护完好通道，同时由跨注意力填补器在潜在空间中修复退化通道（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 提出质量感知的跨模态潜在填补与融合框架QA-CMIF，通过逐通道独立编码、软门控可靠性评估、置信度加权残差旁路保护完好通道以及跨注意力填补修复退化通道，实现对电极故障容错的精准轻量级sEMG-惯性手部手势识别。
en_tdlr: QA-CMIF is an accurate and lightweight quality-aware cross-modal latent imputation and fusion framework that achieves fault-tolerant sEMG-inertial hand gesture recognition by independently encoding each channel, scoring reliability with soft gates, protecting intact channels via confidence-weighted residual bypass, and repairing degraded channels with a cross-attention imputer.
